title: Verify the "Add to Cart" functionality of the MyBooks application
description:
## Description
Check the "Add to Cart" functionality in the application: every way a product can get into the cart, and every scenario in which this functionality is used.

Context given by the requester: the application's stories, test cases and bugs are tracked in Jira project REF (https://example.invalid/2). Application code: https://github.com/person-1/MyBooks. Stand: local docker.

## Acceptance criteria
- Every path by which a product can be added to the cart is identified and checked.
- Every scenario in which the Add to Cart functionality is used is identified and checked.
